description:
Logic.start_compaction/1 hands Database.compact/4 the CURRENT page map (IndexManager.get_complete_page_map/1, index_manager.ex:268 takes the head of versions) but Database.compact labels the result with the OLD durable version (database.ex:137-142). The cutover then installs those pages as versions: [{durable_version, ...}], current_version: durable_version (server.ex:504-513) and re-pulls from durable_version (server.ex:542). The stream re-delivers (durable_version, current_version] and re-applies transactions whose effects are ALREADY baked into the compacted pages.

Idempotent {:set, k, v} hides this, which is why compaction_cutover_test.exs passes. {:atomic, op, ...} is a read-modify-write (index_update.ex:251-256) and does not. Probed on a live worker with a single {:atomic, :add, "ctr", 1} at v1000 and one cutover:

  counter before cutover: <<1,0,0,0,0,0,0,0>>
  counter after  cutover: <<2,0,0,0,0,0,0,0>>

Already live via upload_snapshot_before_spindown/1 (logic.ex:532-541), which uses the identical get_complete_page_map + Database.compact shape, so a spin-down/revival cycle corrupts atomics the same way today. Nothing in lib/ drives the :compact call, so the cutover proper is currently only reachable from tests.

Fix: label the compacted index with current_version, or compact only the durable page map so the re-delivered suffix is genuinely absent from it.

Found by the cold audit on bedrock-zi44, which declined to drive this cutover on a timer because of it.

comments.text: Draft PR: https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/pull/276 — compaction now takes the durable page map, not the live one, so the label matches the contents; stacked on #253. Cold audit PASS-WITH-NOTES; follow-ups filed as bedrock-0lx and bedrock-ngl.

title: Olivine compaction cutover double-applies atomic mutations
